description: This file defines a utility module for aggregating agent usage and cost data across session tracking and LLM costs collections in a MongoDB database. It provides a main function `aggregateAgentsUsageAndCost` that supports filtering by tenant, project, and date ranges, and processes data to produce summarized usage and cost metrics per agent.

methods.description: Main function that performs complex aggregation over session_tracking and llm-costs collections to produce per-agent costs, usage, and session counts, with optional filtering.
